vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: Back-formation of the inconjugable verb or phrase حَبَّذَا (ḥabbaḏā, “the subject appreciates it, favourably, it would be preferred”), itself univerbation of حَبَّ (ḥabba, “to like”) + ذَا (ḏā, “this”).
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
